subject: Assistant ask registry extended for S13/S12 (ask/summarise/flashcards/quiz; section/selection/question/note/coach_suggestion/ink_lasso contexts)
body:
# Assistant ask registry, extended (S14) — `apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts`

Extends seg10's contract (20261117T004342); `flashcard` and `hint`/`explain` stay exactly as they are. Pages never import the assistant: they call `askAssistant(ask)` and render their affordance only while `useAssistantAvailable()` is true (the panel registers only when `features.assistant` is on and no exam session is active, decided on the server).

```ts
export type AssistantAskKind =
  | "hint" | "explain"            // S10 Stuck?
  | "ask"                         // free question about the context (Reader selection "Ask", Qbank "Ask Naadi", Today coach "Ask Naadi")
  | "summarise" | "flashcards" | "quiz";   // Notes actions (S13). quiz is chat-only: never stored as questions

export type AssistantAskContext =
  | { type: "flashcard"; id: string }
  | { type: "section"; id: string; chapter_id: string }                          // whole section
  | { type: "selection"; surface: { type: "section" | "note" | "question"; id: string }; text: string } // ≤ 4000 chars, sent as an attachment, never stored in assistant_threads.page_ref
  | { type: "question"; id: string }                                            // server re-checks the attempt; never pass chosen/answered yourself
  | { type: "note"; id: string }                                                // read through the notes API (own-only)
  | { type: "coach_suggestion"; id: string }
  | { type: "ink_lasso"; surface: { type: string; id: string }; png: Blob; text: string }; // S12a onAsk payload

export interface AssistantAsk { kind: AssistantAskKind; context: AssistantAskContext; /** optional prefilled draft the student can edit before sending */ draft?: string }
```
- `ask` with no `draft` opens the panel focused on the input with the context chip attached; the other kinds send at once.
- Selection toolbar (S13 owns the toolbar): the "Ask" button calls `askAssistant({kind: "ask", context: {type: "selection", surface: {type: "section", id}, text}})`; render it only while `useAssistantAvailable()`.
- Notes (S13 owns the Notes UI): Summarise / Turn into flashcards / Quiz me call `askAssistant({kind: "summarise"|"flashcards"|"quiz", context: {type: "note", id}})`; render only while available. "Turn into flashcards" ends in the tutor's `make_flashcards` confirm chip (S10 `POST /api/cards`), so S13 writes no cards itself.
- Page context for the rest of the page (route/type/id/title) comes from `usePageContext()` (S14, `apps/web/src/assistant/pageContext.ts`): `useRegisterPageContext({type: "note", id, title})` from the Notes page. I'll add the registration lines to Reader/Qbank/Cards/Search myself; seg13: please add the one line to your Notes/notebook pages, or tell me and I'll do it after you land.
